title: מבצר בלמונט (צובה) - 1987 (Belmont Castle, Zuba - 1987)
author: R. P. Harper, D. Pringle
location_note: Zova; the castle's map reference (1620/1325) is printed in the first season's report (HA 89), not here.
notes: Crusader castle, Byzantine church mosaic below it, Persian yhd seal impressions in fills. No English version among the phase-2 ESI 7-8 reports.

features.subtype: series of basins for processing agricultural produce along the south wall of the inner courtyard
features.quote: וסידרה של אגנים לעיבוד תוצרת חקלאית

title: מבצר בלמונט (צובה) - 1988 (Belmont Castle, Zuba - 1988)
author: R. P. Harper, D. Pringle
location_note: Zova (HA 89 map reference 1620/1325); no map reference here.

features.subtype: three reservoirs in the courtyard and probably a fourth under the east wing, fed by roof channels
features.period: basic plan formed when the 12th-c. castle was built; later use

features.subtype: network of channels and gutters draining roofs to the reservoirs
several reservoirs on the summit possibly belonging to the Byzantine settlement or earlier
features.quote: ומספר מאגרי־מים בפיסגת האתר עשויים להתייחס

features.subtype: hoard of alloy tokens in a damaged water channel under a vaulted cellar
features.quote: בתעלת מים פגועה נמצא מטמון אסימוני

features.subtype: winepress installed in the north of the cellar, its floor on a vault over a rock fissure

title: חוף עין גדי (ʿEn Gedi Shore)
author: G. Hadas
location_note: ʿEn Gedi shore of the Dead Sea; no map reference.
notes: Three stone anchors, one tied to a double rope (radiocarbon 4th-3rd c. BCE). No feature of the eligible classes.
